title: feat(ui): show per-turn token in/cached/out chip on Kimi answers
context:
wire_tail._attach_kimi_wire_usage already stamps tokens_in/tokens_out/
tokens_cached on each Kimi assistant event server-side, matching the
fields the generic Claude/Antigravity branch already renders a chip
from -- but the kimi branch continues before reaching that code, so
the metadata row (turn number, timestamp, speak/copy) never got one.
Reuse the same _formatAntigravityTokenChips formatter for parity.

- static/app.js: append the chip to .kimi-answer-meta's innerHTML
- static/app.css: righ
